services_intro: Each consultation is tailored to your birth details and the questions you bring. Reach out to discuss which service fits your situation, or book directly.

services_grid.title: Horoscope Consultation
services_grid.text: A complete reading of your birth chart (Kundli), covering personality, strengths, challenges, and life direction.

services_grid.title: Match Making
services_grid.text: Compatibility analysis between two charts using Guna Milan and detailed planetary comparison for marriage.

services_grid.title: Marriage
services_grid.text: Guidance on marriage timing, potential delays, and remedies, along with pre and post marriage counselling.

services_grid.title: Child Related
services_grid.text: Consultations on conception timing, a child's birth chart, education, and early life guidance.

services_grid.title: Health
services_grid.text: Understanding health tendencies indicated in the chart, and timing of favorable periods for treatment or recovery.

services_grid.title: Job / Career
services_grid.text: Guidance on career changes, business decisions, promotions, and identifying favorable periods for growth.

services_grid.title: Properties / Wealth
services_grid.text: Insight on timing for property purchases, investments, and overall wealth and financial planning indicated by the chart.

services_grid.title: Zoom / Video Consulting
services_grid.text: Full consultations conducted over video call for clients outside Mumbai, or for added convenience.

services_grid.title: Muhurat
services_grid.text: Selection of auspicious dates and times for weddings, housewarmings, business launches, and other important events.

services_grid.title: Mini Consultations
services_grid.text: Shorter, focused follow up sessions for repeat clients who have questions on a specific, ongoing matter.

languages_text: Consultations are available in multiple languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, and Gujarati.
pricing_text: Fees are shared during your enquiry, based on the nature and depth of guidance required.
